  have hd : d.support ⊆ d.support ∪ e.support := Finset.subset_union_left
  rw [Finsupp.prod_of_support_subset _ hd _ fun _ _ ↦ Nat.choose_zero_right _,
    Finsupp.prod_of_support_subset _ Finset.subset_union_right _

    Finsupp.prod_of_support_subset _ hd _ fun _ _ ↦ Nat.choose_zero_right _,
    Finsupp.prod_of_support_subset _ Finsupp.support_add _ fun _ _ ↦ Nat.choose_zero_right _,
    ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]

    simpa [← add_assoc, mul_comm, ← Nat.choose_symm_add (a := d i) (b := e i)] using
      (Nat.choose_mul (n := f i + d i + e i) (k := d i + e i) (s := e i)
        (Nat.le_add_left (e i) (d i))).symm

source:
theorem index_unique [Unique σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (α : σ → ℝ) (r : σ → ℕ) :
    index P α r =
      (Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (α default) (uniqueAlgEquiv ℝ σ P) : ℝ) / r default := by
  set q := Polynomial.taylor (α default) (uniqueAlgEquiv ℝ σ P) with hqdef
  have key (d : σ →₀ ℕ) : eval α (hasseDeriv d P) = q.coeff (d default) := by
    rw [Polynomial.taylor_coeff, ← uniqueAlgEquiv_hasseDeriv, ← Finsupp.unique_single d]
    exact (eval₂_uniqueAlgEquiv (f := hasseDeriv d P) (φ := RingHom.id ℝ) (a := α)).symm
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [hqdef, Ne, Polynomial.taylor_eq_zero, map_eq_zero_iff _ (uniqueAlgEquiv ℝ σ).injective]
  rw [Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree, ← Polynomial.taylor_apply]
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa [weight, hqdef] using index_le_weight (P := P) (α := α) (r := r)
      (d := Finsupp.single default q.natTrailingDegree)
      (by simpa [key] using Polynomial.trailingCoeff_nonzero_iff_nonzero.2 hq)
  · refine (le_index_iff hP).2 fun d hd ↦ ?_
    simpa [weight, hqdef] using div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (by exact_mod_cast Polynomial.natTrailingDegree_le_of_ne_zero (key d ▸ hd))
      (Nat.cast_nonneg (r default))

    ∑ j ∈ range (r + 1), (lam - 1 + 2 * (j : ℝ) / r)⁻¹ ≤ (r + 1) * (lam / (lam ^ 2 - 1)) := by
  have hr' : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have h := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j (hj : j ∈ range (r + 1)) ↦ by
    have hjr : j ≤ r := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 hj)
    have hx2 : 2 * (j : ℝ) / r ≤ 2 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hr']
      gcongr
    simpa only [show 2 - 2 * (j : ℝ) / r = 2 * ((r + 1 - 1 - j : ℕ) : ℝ) / r by
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.cast_sub hjr]

  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_range_reflect (fun j : ℕ ↦ (lam - 1 + 2 * (j : ℝ) / r)⁻¹),
    Finset.sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_div_assoc] at h
  push_cast at h
  linarith

        ((n : ℝ) - t) / 2).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * √(n : ℝ) / t * ∏ j, (((r ∘ Fin.castSucc) j : ℝ) + 1)) :
    (((box r).filter fun d ↦ weight r d ≤ (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - lam) / 2).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / lam * ∏ j, ((r j : ℝ) + 1) := by
  set R := r (Fin.last n)
  have hs := sum_inv_lt (r := R) (m := n + 1) hr (Nat.succ_le_succ hn) hlam
  push_cast [add_sub_cancel_right] at hs
  rw [card_filter_box_last, Nat.cast_sum,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ card_filter_fiber_eq r lam i]

          weight (r ∘ Fin.castSucc) d ≤ ((n : ℝ) - (lam - 1 + 2 * (i : ℝ) / R)) / 2).card : ℝ)

          ∏ j, (((r ∘ Fin.castSucc) j : ℝ) + 1) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ ih ?_
        linarith [Real.one_le_sqrt.2 (by simp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)),
          show 0 ≤ 2 * (i : ℝ) / R by positivity]
    _ = 2 * √(n : ℝ) * (∏ j, (((r ∘ Fin.castSucc) j : ℝ) + 1)) *
          ∑ i ∈ range (R + 1), (lam - 1 + 2 * (i : ℝ) / R)⁻¹ := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ by ring
    _ ≤ 2 * √(n : ℝ) * (∏ j, (((r ∘ Fin.castSucc) j : ℝ) + 1)) *

private lemma exists_pos_div_rpow_lt_aux {x κ : ℝ} (hx : Irrational x)
    (hs : (Roth.approxSet x κ).Finite) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (p q : ℤ), 0 < q → C / (q : ℝ) ^ κ < |x - (p : ℝ) / q| := by
  let f : ℤ × ℕ → ℝ := fun a ↦ |x - (a.1 : ℝ) / a.2| * (a.2 : ℝ) ^ κ
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hmin⟩ := Set.exists_min_image _ f (hs.insert (0, 1))
    (Set.insert_nonempty (0, 1) _)
  have haq : 0 < a.2 := by
    rcases ha with rfl | ha <;> first | exact ha.1 | norm_num
  have hfa : 0 < f a := mul_pos
    (abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr (by simpa using hx.ne_rational a.1 a.2)))
    (rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _)
  refine ⟨min (1 / 2) (f a / 2), by positivity, fun p q hq ↦ ?_⟩
  lift q to ℕ using hq.le
  have hq' : 0 < (q : ℝ) ^ κ := rpow_pos_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hq) _
  rw [Int.cast_natCast, div_lt_iff₀ hq']
  by_cases hmem : (p, q) ∈ Roth.approxSet x κ
  · exact (min_le_right _ _).trans_lt
      ((half_lt_self hfa).trans_le (hmin (p, q) (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hmem)))
  · apply ((min_le_left _ _).trans_lt (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) / 2 < 1)).trans_le

theorem isDiophantine_iff {x : ℝ} (hx : Irrational x) :
    IsDiophantine x ↔ ∀ {κ : ℝ}, (Roth.approxSet x κ).Infinite → κ ≤ 2 := by
  refine ⟨fun h κ hinf ↦ le_of_not_gt fun hκ ↦ ?_, fun h ε hε ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := h ((κ - 2) / 2) (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := Roth.eventually_div_rpow_lt (M := 1 / C)
      (by linarith : 2 + (κ - 2) / 2 < κ)
    obtain ⟨⟨p, q⟩, hpq, hq⟩ :=
      (hinf.sdiff (Roth.approxSet_den_le_finite x κ Q)).nonempty
    have hgap : 1 / (q : ℝ) ^ κ < C / (q : ℝ) ^ (2 + (κ - 2) / 2) := by
      simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, hC.ne'] using
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (hQ q (lt_of_not_ge fun h ↦ hq ⟨hpq, h⟩)) hC
    exact (hpq.2.trans hgap).not_gt (by simpa using hbound p q (by exact_mod_cast hpq.1))
  · apply exists_pos_div_rpow_lt_aux hx
    exact Set.not_infinite.mp fun hinf ↦
      (by linarith : ¬ (2 + ε ≤ 2)) (h hinf)

theorem approxSet_den_le_finite (α κ : ℝ) (Q₀ : ℕ) : {hq ∈ approxSet α κ | hq.2 ≤ Q₀}.Finite := by
  set S : ℝ := ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q₀, 1 / (q : ℝ) ^ κ
  set K : ℤ := ⌈(Q₀ : ℝ) * (|α| + S)⌉
  refine (Finset.finite_toSet (Finset.Icc (-K) K ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 Q₀)).subset ?_
  rintro ⟨h, q⟩ ⟨⟨hq0, happ⟩, hqQ⟩
  simp only at hq0 happ hqQ
  have hqR : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq0
  have hdiv : |(h : ℝ) / q| ≤ |α| + S := by
    rw [abs_sub_comm] at happ
    linarith only [happ, abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub ((h : ℝ) / q) α,
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun q : ℕ ↦ 1 / (q : ℝ) ^ κ) (fun i _ ↦ by positivity)
        (Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨hq0, hqQ⟩)]
  have habs : |(h : ℝ)| ≤ Q₀ * (|α| + S) := by
    have hqQR : (q : ℝ) ≤ Q₀ := by exact_mod_cast hqQ
    have hh : |(h : ℝ)| / q ≤ |α| + S := by simpa [abs_div] using hdiv
    simpa [mul_comm] using ((div_le_iff₀ hqR).1 hh).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqQR ((abs_nonneg _).trans hdiv))
  have hK' : |h| ≤ K := by
    have : ((|h| : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ K := by
      rw [Int.cast_abs]
      exact habs.trans (Int.le_ceil _)
    exact_mod_cast this
  simp only [Finset.coe_product, Set.mem_prod, Finset.coe_Icc, Set.mem_Icc]
  exact ⟨abs_le.1 hK', hq0, hqQ⟩

theorem exists_reduced_approx {α : ℝ} (hα : Irrational α) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hinf : (approxSet α κ).Infinite) (Q₀ : ℕ) : ∃ hq ∈ approxSet α κ, Q₀ < hq.2 ∧
    IsCoprime hq.1 (hq.2 : ℤ) := by
  by_contra! hcon
  set ρ : ℤ × ℕ → ℚ := fun hq ↦ (hq.1 : ℚ) / hq.2
  have hV : (ρ '' approxSet α κ).Finite := by
    refine ((approxSet_den_le_finite α κ Q₀).image ρ).subset ?_
    rintro _ ⟨hq, hmem, rfl⟩
    -- the reduced form of a solution is a reduced solution
    have hm : ((ρ hq).num, (ρ hq).den) ∈ approxSet α κ :=
      approxSet_num_den_mem_aux hκ.le hmem
    refine ⟨((ρ hq).num, (ρ hq).den), ⟨hm, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · by_contra! hc
      exact hcon _ hm hc (Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.2 (ρ hq).reduced)
    · exact Rat.num_div_den (ρ hq)
  have hfib : ∀ x ∈ ρ '' approxSet α κ, {hq ∈ approxSet α κ | ρ hq = x}.Finite := by
    intro x _
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_div_rpow_lt (M := 1 / |α - (x : ℝ)|) hκ

theorem exists_m {n : ℕ} {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 2 < κ) : ∃ m : ℕ, 16 * n ^ 2 < m ∧ 4 * n * √(m : ℝ) < m ∧
    2 * m / (m - 4 * n * √(m : ℝ)) < κ := by
  let s := ⌈4 * κ * n / (κ - 2)⌉₊ + 4 * n + 1
  have hs4 : 4 * n < s := by
    dsimp [s]
    lia
  have hs4R : (4 * n : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hs4
  have hspos : (0 : ℝ) < s := (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)).trans_lt hs4R
  have hkey : 4 * κ * n < (s : ℝ) * (κ - 2) := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hκ)).mp
    refine (Nat.le_ceil _).trans_lt ?_
    exact_mod_cast (show ⌈4 * κ * n / (κ - 2)⌉₊ < s by
      dsimp [s]
      lia)
  have hmul : 4 * n * (s : ℝ) < (s : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [pow_two] using mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hs4R hspos

    rw [Real.sqrt_sq (Nat.cast_nonneg _), div_lt_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hmul)]
    nlinarith only [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hkey hspos]

theorem exists_delta {n m : ℕ} (hm : 16 * n ^ 2 < m) {κ : ℝ}
    (h47' : 2 * m / (m - 4 * n * √(m : ℝ)) < κ) : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < 1 / m ∧
    eta δ m + 2 * (1 + 3 * δ) * n * √(m : ℝ) < m / 2 ∧
    (m : ℝ) * (1 + 4 * δ) / (gam δ n m - eta δ m) < κ := by
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hδ₀'⟩ := exists_delta_bound hm
  have hc : ContinuousAt (fun δ ↦
      (m : ℝ) * (1 + 4 * δ) / (gam δ n m - eta δ m)) 0 :=
    (show ContinuousAt (fun δ : ℝ ↦ (m : ℝ) * (1 + 4 * δ)) 0 from
      continuousAt_const.mul (continuousAt_const.add (continuousAt_const.mul continuousAt_id))).div
      ((show ContinuousAt (fun δ ↦ gam δ n m) 0 from
        (continuousAt_const.sub (((continuousAt_const.mul
          (continuousAt_const.add (continuousAt_const.mul continuousAt_id))).mul
            continuousAt_const).mul continuousAt_const)).div_const 2).sub
        ((Real.continuousAt_rpow_const 0 _ (.inr (by positivity))).const_mul _))
      (sub_pos.mpr ((eta_lt_gam_iff 0 n m).mp (hδ₀' 0 le_rfl hδ₀.le).2)).ne'
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hbound⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp
    (hc.eventually_lt continuousAt_const (by
      simpa [gam, lam, eta, Real.zero_rpow (by positivity : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m ≠ 0),
        div_div_eq_mul_div, mul_comm] using h47'))
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hlt⟩ := exists_between (lt_min hδ₀ hε)
  obtain ⟨h29, h30⟩ := hδ₀' δ hδ.le (hlt.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)).le
  exact ⟨δ, hδ, h29, h30,
    hbound (y := δ) (by simpa [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_pos hδ] using hlt.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))⟩

theorem exists_approximants {α : ℝ} (hα : Irrational α) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ)

    ∃ (h : Fin m → ℤ) (q : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ j, (h j, q j) ∈ approxSet α κ) ∧
      (∀ j, IsCoprime (h j) (q j : ℤ)) ∧ (∀ j, 1 < q j) ∧ L < Real.log (q 0) ∧ ∀ i j : Fin m,
      i.val + 1 = j.val → 2 / δ * Real.log (q i) < Real.log (q j) := by
  choose g hgmem hglt hgcop using fun Q₀ : ℕ ↦ exists_reduced_approx hα hκ hinf Q₀
  let s : ℕ → ℤ × ℕ := Nat.rec (g (max ⌈Real.exp L⌉₊ 1))
    (fun _ p ↦ g (max ⌈(p.2 : ℝ) ^ (2 / δ)⌉₊ 1))
  have hmem : ∀ k, s k ∈ approxSet α κ ∧ IsCoprime (s k).1 ((s k).2 : ℤ) ∧ 1 < (s k).2 := by
    rintro (_ | k) <;> exact ⟨hgmem _, hgcop _, (le_max_right _ _).trans_lt (hglt _)⟩
  refine ⟨fun j ↦ (s j).1, fun j ↦ (s j).2, fun j ↦ (hmem j).1, fun j ↦ (hmem j).2.1,
    fun j ↦ (hmem j).2.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hlt : Real.exp L < ((g (max ⌈Real.exp L⌉₊ 1)).2 : ℝ) :=
      (Nat.le_ceil _).trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast (le_max_left _ _).trans_lt (hglt _))
    exact (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt ((Real.exp_pos L).trans hlt)).2 hlt
  · intro i j hij
    change 2 / δ * Real.log ((s i).2) < Real.log ((s j).2)
    rw [hij.symm]
    apply Real.lt_log_of_rpow_lt (by exact_mod_cast zero_lt_one.trans (hmem i).2.2)
    exact (Nat.le_ceil _).trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast (le_max_left _ _).trans_lt (hglt _))

theorem exists_degrees {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) {q : Fin m → ℕ}

      (∀ j, 10 / δ < r j) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin m, i.val + 1 = j.val → (r j : ℝ) / δ < r i) ∧
      (∀ j, (r 0 : ℝ) * Real.log (q 0) ≤ r j * Real.log (q j)) ∧ ∀ j,

      simpa only [mul_assoc] using

theorem one_le_prod_pow_mul_abs_eval {m : ℕ} (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℤ) {r : Fin m → ℕ}
    (hQ : ∀ j, degreeOf j Q ≤ r j) (h : Fin m → ℤ) {q : Fin m → ℕ} (hq : ∀ j, 0 < q j)
    (hne : eval (fun j ↦ (h j : ℝ) / q j) (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) Q) ≠ 0) :
    1 ≤ (∏ j, (q j : ℝ) ^ r j) * |eval (fun j ↦ (h j : ℝ) / q j) (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) Q)| := by
  have hqR : ∀ j, (0 : ℝ) < q j := fun j ↦ by exact_mod_cast hq j
  have hP : (0 : ℝ) < ∏ j, (q j : ℝ) ^ r j := Finset.prod_pos fun j _ ↦ pow_pos (hqR j) _
  set N : ℤ := ∑ d ∈ Q.support, Q.coeff d * ∏ j, h j ^ d j * (q j : ℤ) ^ (r j - d j) with hN
  have hNeq : (N : ℝ) = (∏ j, (q j : ℝ) ^ r j) *
      eval (fun j ↦ (h j : ℝ) / q j) (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) Q) := by
    rw [eval_eq', support_map_of_injective _ Int.cast_injective, Finset.mul_sum, hN]
    push_cast
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d hd ↦ ?_
    rw [coeff_map, mul_left_comm, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [← pow_sub_mul_pow (q j : ℝ) ((monomial_le_degreeOf j hd).trans (hQ j)), div_pow]
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (pow_ne_zero _ (hqR j).ne'), mul_comm]
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(N : ℝ)| := by
    rw [← Int.cast_abs]
    exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs (Int.cast_ne_zero.mp (hNeq.symm ▸ mul_ne_zero hP.ne' hne))
  rwa [hNeq, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hP] at h1

private lemma abs_prod_pow_le_rpow_of_le_weight {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {r q : Fin m → ℕ}
    (hq : ∀ j, 0 < q j) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) {x : Fin m → ℝ} (hx : ∀ j, |x j| ≤ 1 / (q j : ℝ) ^ κ)
    (hqr : ∀ j, (q 0 : ℝ) ^ ((r 0 : ℝ) / r j) ≤ q j) (d : Fin m →₀ ℕ) {c : ℝ} (hw : c ≤ weight r d)
    : |∏ j, x j ^ d j| ≤ (q 0 : ℝ) ^ (-(r 0 : ℝ) * c * κ) := by
  have hqR : ∀ j, (0 : ℝ) < q j := fun j ↦ by exact_mod_cast hq j
  have hq1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq 0
  rw [Finset.abs_prod]
  calc ∏ j, |x j ^ d j|
      ≤ ∏ j, (q j : ℝ) ^ (-κ * d j) := by
        refine Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun j _ ↦ abs_nonneg _) fun j _ ↦ ?_
        rw [abs_pow, Real.rpow_mul (hqR j).le, Real.rpow_natCast,
          Real.rpow_neg (hqR j).le, ← one_div]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hx j) _
    _ ≤ ∏ j, ((q 0 : ℝ) ^ ((r 0 : ℝ) / r j)) ^ (-κ * d j) := by
        refine Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun j _ ↦ by positivity) fun j _ ↦ ?_
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) (hqr j)
          (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.2 hκ) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    _ = (q 0 : ℝ) ^ (-(r 0 : ℝ) * κ * weight r d) := by
        simp_rw [← Real.rpow_mul (hqR 0).le]
        rw [← Real.rpow_sum_of_pos (hqR 0), weight, Finset.mul_sum]
        exact congrArg _ (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ by ring)
    _ ≤ (q 0 : ℝ) ^ (-(r 0 : ℝ) * c * κ) := by
        apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hq1
        convert mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hw
          (neg_nonpos.2 (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (r 0)) hκ)) using 1 <;> ring

theorem abs_eval_lt_of_le_index {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {Q : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℝ} {r : Fin m → ℕ}

    {q : Fin m → ℕ} (hq : ∀ j, 0 < q j) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)
    (happ : ∀ j, |α - (h j : ℝ) / q j| ≤ 1 / (q j : ℝ) ^ κ)
    (hqr : ∀ j, (q 0 : ℝ) ^ ((r 0 : ℝ) / r j) ≤ q j) {C : ℝ}
    (hC : ∀ i : Fin m →₀ ℕ, |eval (fun _ ↦ α) (hasseDeriv i Q)| < C) :
    |eval (fun j ↦ (h j : ℝ) / q j) Q| < (∏ j, ((r j : ℝ) + 1)) * C *
      (q 0 : ℝ) ^ (-(r 0 : ℝ) * c * κ) := by
  have hT : 0 < (q 0 : ℝ) ^ (-(r 0 : ℝ) * c * κ) :=
    Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hq 0) _
  rw [eval_eq_sum_box (fun _ ↦ α) (fun j ↦ (h j : ℝ) / q j) r Q hd]
  -- each term of the Taylor expansion is small
  have hterm : ∀ d ∈ box r, |eval (fun _ ↦ α) (hasseDeriv d Q) *
      ∏ j, ((h j : ℝ) / q j - α) ^ d j| < C * (q 0 : ℝ) ^ (-(r 0 : ℝ) * c * κ) := by
    intro d _
    by_cases h0 : eval (fun _ ↦ α) (hasseDeriv d Q) = 0
    · rw [h0, zero_mul, abs_zero]
      exact mul_pos (lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_nonneg _) (hC 0)) hT
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le_of_nonneg_of_pos (hC d)
      (abs_prod_pow_le_rpow_of_le_weight hq hκ (fun j ↦ by
        simpa only [abs_sub_comm] using happ j) hqr d (hidx.trans (index_le_weight h0)))
      (abs_nonneg _) hT
  refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans_lt ?_
  convert Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty ⟨0, mem_box.2 fun j ↦ Nat.zero_le _⟩ hterm using 1
  rw [Finset.sum_const, card_box, nsmul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  ring

private lemma exists_roth_parameters_aux {α κ : ℝ} (hint : IsIntegral ℤ α) (hκ : 2 < κ) :
    ∃ (f : Polynomial ℤ) (A : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (δ : ℝ), f.Monic ∧ Polynomial.aeval α f = 0 ∧ 1 ≤ A ∧
      (∀ i, |(f.coeff i : ℝ)| ≤ A) ∧ 2 ≤ m ∧ 0 < δ ∧ δ < 1 / m ∧
      eta δ m + 2 * (1 + 3 * δ) * f.natDegree * √(m : ℝ) < m / 2 ∧
      (m : ℝ) * (1 + 4 * δ) / (gam δ f.natDegree m - eta δ m) < κ := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfα, hdeg⟩ := exists_monic_aeval_eq_zero hint
  -- a bound for the coefficients of `f`
  let A : ℝ := 1 + ∑ i ∈ f.support, |(f.coeff i : ℝ)|
  -- choice of `m` and `δ`
  obtain ⟨m, hm, -, h47'⟩ := exists_m (n := f.natDegree) hκ
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδm, h30, h49⟩ := exists_delta hm h47'
  refine ⟨f, A, m, δ, hf, hfα, ?_, ?_, ?_, hδ0, hδm, h30, h49⟩
  · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ abs_nonneg _)
  · intro i
    exact (Finsupp.single_eval_le_sum f.toFinsupp.coeff (g := fun z : ℤ ↦ |(z : ℝ)|)
      (by simp) (fun _ ↦ abs_nonneg _) i).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one)
  · nlinarith only [hm, hdeg]

private lemma exists_roth_approximants_aux {α κ : ℝ} (hα : Irrational α) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hinf : (approxSet α κ).Infinite) (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (A : ℝ) : ∃ (h : Fin m → ℤ) (q r : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ j, (h j, q j) ∈ approxSet α κ) ∧
      (∀ j, IsCoprime (h j) (q j : ℤ)) ∧ (∀ j, 1 < q j) ∧ (∀ j, 0 < r j) ∧ 3 ≤ r (Fin.rev 0) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin m, i.val + 1 = j.val → (r j : ℝ) / δ ≤ r i) ∧ (∀ j, r j ≤ r 0) ∧
      (2 * m + 1 + 2 * m * Real.log (1 + A) + 2 * m * Real.log (1 + |α|) < δ ^ 2 * Real.log (q 0)) ∧
      (∀ j, (r 0 : ℝ) * Real.log (q 0) ≤ r j * Real.log (q j)) ∧
      ∀ j, (r j : ℝ) * Real.log (q j) < (1 + δ / 10) * (r 0 * Real.log (q 0)) := by
  -- the approximants and the degrees
  obtain ⟨h, q, happ, hcop, hq1, hL, h50⟩ := exists_approximants hα hκ hinf m
    ((2 * m + 1 + 2 * m * Real.log (1 + A) + 2 * m * Real.log (1 + |α|)) / δ ^ 2)
  obtain ⟨r, hr0, h31a, h31b, h33, h53⟩ := exists_degrees hδ0 hδ1 hq1
    (fun i j hij ↦ (h50 i j hij).le)
  have hranti : Antitone r := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne m)
    refine Fin.antitone_iff_succ_le.2 fun i ↦ ?_
    exact_mod_cast (le_div_self (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hδ0 hδ1).trans
      (h31b i.castSucc i.succ rfl).le
  refine ⟨h, q, r, happ, hcop, hq1, hr0, ?_, fun i j hij ↦ (h31b i j hij).le,
    fun j ↦ hranti (Fin.zero_le j), (div_lt_iff₀' (by positivity)).1 hL, h33, h53⟩
  exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) ≤ 10).trans
    ((le_div_self (by norm_num) hδ0 hδ1).trans (h31a (Fin.rev 0)).le)

private lemma roth_product_bound_aux {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {α A δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    {q r : Fin m → ℕ} (hr0 : 0 < r 0) (hr0max : ∀ j, r j ≤ r 0)
    (h32 : 2 * m + 1 + 2 * m * Real.log (1 + A) + 2 * m * Real.log (1 + |α|) ≤
      δ ^ 2 * Real.log (q 0)) : 0 < (mainCoeffBound δ (q 0) (r 0) : ℝ) ∧
      (mainCoeffBound δ (q 0) (r 0) : ℝ) ≤ (q 0 : ℝ) ^ (δ * r 0) ∧
      (∏ j, ((r j : ℝ) + 1)) < (mainCoeffBound δ (q 0) (r 0) : ℝ) ^ δ := by
  -- `B` is at most `q_0^{δ r_0}` and `∏ (r_j + 1) < B^δ`
  have hm1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (NeZero.ne m)
  have h32' : 3 ≤ δ ^ 2 * Real.log (q 0) := by
    have := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) (Real.log_nonneg (le_add_of_nonneg_right hA))
    have := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m)
      (Real.log_nonneg (le_add_of_nonneg_right (abs_nonneg α)))
    linarith
  obtain ⟨hsqB, hBX⟩ := sqrt_lt_floor ((by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 4).trans
    (four_lt_rpow hδ0 hr0 h32').le)
  refine ⟨(Real.sqrt_nonneg _).trans_lt hsqB, hBX, ?_⟩
  have hprod : ∏ j, (r j + 1) ≤ (2 ^ r 0) ^ m := by
    simpa using Finset.prod_le_pow_card Finset.univ (fun j ↦ r j + 1) (2 ^ r 0)
      (fun j _ ↦ Nat.lt_two_pow_self.trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (hr0max j)))
  have hprodR : (∏ j, ((r j : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (m * r 0) := by
    exact_mod_cast (by simpa [← pow_mul, mul_comm] using hprod)
  exact hprodR.trans_lt (three_small_factors hδ0 hr0 hA h32).1

private lemma roth_log_bound_aux {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hm2 : 2 ≤ m) {δ G κ B : ℝ} (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    {q r : Fin m → ℕ} (hq1 : ∀ j, 1 < q j)
    (h53 : ∀ j, (r j : ℝ) * Real.log (q j) < (1 + δ / 10) * (r 0 * Real.log (q 0))) (hBpos : 0 < B)
    (hBX : B ≤ (q 0 : ℝ) ^ (δ * r 0)) (hN : (∏ j, ((r j : ℝ) + 1)) < B ^ δ)
    (hone : 1 < (∏ j, (q j : ℝ) ^ r j) * ((∏ j, ((r j : ℝ) + 1)) * B ^ (1 + 3 * δ) *
      (q 0 : ℝ) ^ (-(r 0 : ℝ) * G * κ))) : G * κ < m * (1 + 4 * δ) := by
  have hr0 : 0 < r 0 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h ↦ by simpa [h] using h53 0
  have hK0 := mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.2 hr0) (Real.log_pos (Nat.one_lt_cast.2 (hq1 0)))
  have hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ := le_of_lt <|
    (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 10)).mp <|
    (lt_add_iff_pos_right 1).mp <| (mul_lt_mul_iff_left₀ hK0).mp <| by
      simpa only [one_mul] using h53 0
  have hqR : ∀ j, (0 : ℝ) < q j := fun j ↦ Nat.cast_pos.2 (lt_trans zero_lt_one (hq1 j))
  have hN0 : 0 < ∏ j, ((r j : ℝ) + 1) := Finset.prod_pos fun j _ ↦ Nat.cast_add_one_pos _
  -- take logarithms
  have hlog := Real.log_pos hone
  rw [Real.log_mul (Finset.prod_pos fun j _ ↦ pow_pos (hqR j) _).ne'
      ((mul_pos (mul_pos hN0 (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hBpos _))
        (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hqR 0) _)).ne'),
    Real.log_mul (mul_pos hN0 (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hBpos _)).ne'
      (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hqR 0) _).ne',
    Real.log_mul hN0.ne' (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hBpos _).ne',
    Real.log_rpow hBpos, Real.log_rpow (hqR 0)] at hlog
  have hlogP : Real.log (∏ j, (q j : ℝ) ^ r j) <
      m * ((1 + δ / 10) * (r 0 * Real.log (q 0))) := by
    simp_rw [Real.log_prod (fun j _ ↦ (pow_pos (hqR j) _).ne'), Real.log_pow]
    simpa only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] using
      Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty Finset.univ_nonempty (fun j _ ↦ h53 j)
  have hpos : 0 < m * (1 + δ / 10) + (1 + 4 * δ) * δ - G * κ :=
    (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hK0).mp <| by
      linarith only [hlog, hlogP, (Real.log_lt_log hN0 hN).trans_eq (Real.log_rpow hBpos δ),
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (a := 1 + 4 * δ)
          ((Real.log_le_log hBpos hBX).trans_eq (Real.log_rpow (hqR 0) _)) (by positivity)]
  have hmR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm2
  apply (sub_pos.mp hpos).trans_le
  linarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (by linarith only [hδ1, hmR] : 1 + 4 * δ ≤ (39 / 10) * m) hδ0]

theorem roth_of_isIntegral {α : ℝ} (hα : Irrational α) (hint : IsIntegral ℤ α) {κ : ℝ}
    (hinf : (approxSet α κ).Infinite) : κ ≤ 2 := by
  by_contra! hκ
  obtain ⟨f, A, m, δ, hf, hfα, hA1, hA, hm2, hδ0, hδm, h30, h49⟩ :=
    exists_roth_parameters_aux hint hκ
  have : NeZero m := ⟨by lia⟩
  have hδ1 : δ ≤ 1 := hδm.le.trans (by
    simpa using one_div_le_one_div_of_le zero_lt_one
      (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ m by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (NeZero.ne m)))
  obtain ⟨h, q, r, happ, hcop, hq1, hr0, hrlast, h31b, hr0max, h32, h33, h53⟩ :=
    exists_roth_approximants_aux hα (by linarith) hinf m hδ0 hδ1 A
  obtain ⟨hBpos, hBX, hN⟩ :=
    roth_product_bound_aux hδ0.le (zero_le_one.trans hA1) (hr0 0) hr0max h32.le
  exact ((div_lt_iff₀' (sub_pos.2 ((eta_lt_gam_iff _ _ _).1 h30))).1 h49).not_gt
    (roth_log_bound_aux (κ := κ) hm2 hδ1 hq1 h53 hBpos hBX hN
      (one_lt_roth_eval_bound_aux hf hfα hA hδ0.le hδm.le hr0 hrlast h31b
        (fun j ↦ zero_lt_one.trans (hq1 j)) (by linarith) (fun j ↦ (happ j).2.le) hcop h32.le h33))

source:
theorem exists_delta_bound {n m : ℕ} (hm : 16 * n ^ 2 < m) : ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 ≤ δ →
    δ ≤ δ₀ → δ < 1 / m ∧ eta δ m + 2 * (1 + 3 * δ) * n * √(m : ℝ) < m / 2 := by
  have hm' : (16 * n ^ 2 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hm0 : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_le _).trans_lt hm
  have h4n : 4 * (n : ℝ) < √(m : ℝ) := Real.lt_sqrt_of_sq_lt (by nlinarith only [hm'])
  have hgap : 2 * (n : ℝ) * √(m : ℝ) < m / 2 := by
    nlinarith only [Real.sq_sqrt hm0.le,
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h4n (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hm0)]
  have hc : ContinuousAt (fun δ ↦ eta δ m + 2 * (1 + 3 * δ) * n * √(m : ℝ)) 0 :=
    (Real.continuousAt_rpow_const 0 _ (.inr (by positivity))).const_mul _ |>.add (by fun_prop)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hbound⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp
    (hc.eventually_lt continuousAt_const (by
      simpa [eta, Real.zero_rpow (by positivity : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m ≠ 0)] using hgap))
  refine ⟨min (1 / (m : ℝ)) ε / 2, by positivity, fun δ hδ hle ↦ ?_⟩
  have hlt := hle.trans_lt (half_lt_self (by positivity : 0 < min (1 / (m : ℝ)) ε))
  exact ⟨(lt_min_iff.mp hlt).1,
    hbound (by simpa [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_nonneg hδ] using (lt_min_iff.mp hlt).2)⟩

theorem four_lt_rpow {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) {q₁ r₁ : ℕ} (hr₁ : 0 < r₁)
    (hq₁ : 3 ≤ δ ^ 2 * Real.log q₁) : 4 < (q₁ : ℝ) ^ (δ * r₁) := by
  have hL : 0 < Real.log q₁ :=
    pos_of_mul_pos_right (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hq₁) (sq_nonneg δ)
  have hq : 2 ≤ q₁ := by exact_mod_cast (Real.log_pos_iff (by positivity)).1 hL
  have hlog2 : Real.log 2 < 3 / 4 := by
    apply (Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp (by norm_num)).2
    nlinarith only [Real.quadratic_le_exp_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 4)]
  have hr : (1 : ℝ) ≤ r₁ := by exact_mod_cast hr₁
  apply Real.lt_rpow_of_log_lt <| lt_trans zero_lt_one ((Real.log_pos_iff (by positivity)).1 hL)
  have hkey : Real.log 4 < δ * Real.log q₁ := by
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]
    by_contra! h
    norm_num at h
    nlinarith only [mul_self_le_mul_self (mul_nonneg hδ0 hL.le) h,
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq₁ hL.le,
      Real.log_le_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) (by exact_mod_cast hq : (2 : ℝ) ≤ q₁),
      mul_pos (Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2))
        (by linarith only [hlog2] : 0 < 3 - 4 * Real.log 2)]
  nlinarith only [hkey, le_mul_of_one_le_right (mul_nonneg hδ0 hL.le) hr]

    (1 + |α|) ^ (m * r₁) < (mainCoeffBound δ q₁ r₁ : ℝ) ^ δ := by

  · nlinarith only [h32, hm0, mul_nonneg hm0 hlogA]

    ∃ Q : Polynomial R, Q.natDegree ≤ s - 1 ∧ (∀ i, ‖Q.coeff i‖ ≤ (1 + A) * C) ∧
    P %ₘ f = Q %ₘ f := by
  have : Nontrivial R := Polynomial.Nontrivial.of_polynomial_ne hself
  have hf : f.Monic := by
    by_contra hf
    exact hself (Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_of_not_monic P hf)
  have hP0 : P ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hself (by simp [h])
  have hdeg : f.degree ≤ P.degree := le_of_not_gt fun h ↦
    hself ((Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_self_iff hf).2 h)
  let Q := P - f * (Polynomial.C P.leadingCoeff * Polynomial.X ^ (P.natDegree - f.natDegree))

    conv_lhs =>

theorem norm_coeff_modByMonic_le {R : Type*} [SeminormedRing R] {f : Polynomial R} {A : ℝ}

    (hs : P.natDegree ≤ s) (i : ℕ) : ‖(P %ₘ f).coeff i‖ ≤ (1 + A) ^ (s + 1 - f.natDegree) * C := by
  have hA : 1 ≤ 1 + A := le_add_of_nonneg_right ((norm_nonneg _).trans (hfA 0))
  by_cases hf1 : f = 1
  · simpa [hf1] using mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans hA) (s + 1))
      ((norm_nonneg _).trans (hP 0))
  induction s using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing P C with
  | _ s ih =>
  by_cases hself : P %ₘ f = P
  · simpa [hself] using (hP i).trans
      (le_mul_of_one_le_left ((norm_nonneg _).trans (hP 0)) (one_le_pow₀ hA))
  obtain ⟨hn, hfs, Q, hQdeg, hQc, hmod⟩ := exists_norm_coeff_reduction_aux hfA hP hs hf1 hself
  rw [hmod]
  refine (ih (s - 1) (by lia) Q hQc hQdeg).trans_eq ?_
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]
  congr 2
  lia

theorem pigeonhole_count {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B) {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 ≤ c) {n D N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
    (hD : c * n * D ≤ N / 2) : ((2 * ⌊B ^ c⌋₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (n * D) < (B + 1) ^ N := by
  -- The source sets Y = 2(1+B) and uses the intermediate estimate
  -- `2⌊B^c⌋ + 1 < Y^c`
  -- The helper instead bounds the count directly by `(B + 1)^(2c)`.
  by_cases hk : n * D = 0
  · simpa [hk] using one_lt_pow₀ (by linarith) hN.ne'
  calc
    _ < ((B + 1) ^ (2 * c)) ^ (n * D) :=
      pow_lt_pow_left₀ (floor_rpow_count_lt_aux hB hc) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hk
    _ = (B + 1) ^ (2 * c * (n * D : ℕ)) := (Real.rpow_mul_natCast (by positivity) _ _).symm
    _ ≤ (B + 1) ^ N := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast]
      apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by linarith)
      push_cast
      linarith only [hD]

theorem exists_ne_modByMonic_eq {σ : Type*} (r : σ → ℕ) [Finite (Function.support r)] (B : ℕ)

    (hC : ∀ W ∈ boxFamily r B, ∀ j ∈ J, ∀ i < f.natDegree,
      |(diag (hasseDeriv j W) %ₘ f).coeff i| ≤ C)
    (hcount : ((2 * C + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (f.natDegree * J.card) < ((B : ℝ) + 1) ^ ∏ᶠ j, (r j + 1)) :
    ∃ W' ∈ boxFamily r B, ∃ W'' ∈ boxFamily r B, W' ≠ W'' ∧
      ∀ j ∈ J, diag (hasseDeriv j W') %ₘ f = diag (hasseDeriv j W'') %ₘ f := by
  classical
  let : Fintype (boxFamily r B) := (boxFamily_finite r B).fintype
  let F (W : boxFamily r B) (p : J × Fin f.natDegree) : Set.Icc (-(C : ℤ)) C :=
    ⟨(diag (hasseDeriv p.1.1 W.1) %ₘ f).coeff p.2, abs_le.1 (hC W.1 W.2 p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2.1 p.2.2)⟩
  obtain ⟨W', W'', hne, h⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt F <| by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_ofFinset, Int.card_Icc, sub_neg_eq_add,
      Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_coe, Fintype.card_fin, mul_comm, Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard,
      ncard_boxFamily, show ((C : ℤ) + 1 + C).toNat = 2 * C + 1 by lia] using
      (show (2 * C + 1) ^ (f.natDegree * J.card) < (B + 1) ^ ∏ᶠ j, (r j + 1) by
        exact_mod_cast hcount)
  refine ⟨W', W'.2, W'', W''.2, Subtype.coe_ne_coe.2 hne, fun j hj ↦ ?_⟩

name: Roth.linearIndependent_coordinate_polynomials_aux
source:
private lemma linearIndependent_coordinate_polynomials_aux {R M : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {n l : ℕ} (v : Fin (n + 1) → M)
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin l) R (Submodule.span R (Set.range v))) :
    LinearIndependent R (fun ρ ↦ ∑ ν : Fin (n + 1),
      Polynomial.C (b.repr ⟨v ν, Submodule.subset_span ⟨ν, rfl⟩⟩ ρ) * Polynomial.X ^ (ν : ℕ)) := by
  classical
  let a := fun ν ρ ↦ b.repr ⟨v ν, Submodule.subset_span ⟨ν, rfl⟩⟩ ρ
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg ρ₀
  have hcoeff : ∀ ν : Fin (n + 1), ∑ ρ, g ρ * a ν ρ = 0 := by
    intro ν
    have h1 := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial R ↦ p.coeff ν) hg
    simp only [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_smul, smul_eq_mul,
      Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow, Polynomial.coeff_zero] at h1
    rw [← h1]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ρ _ ↦ ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ν (fun ν' _ hν' ↦ ite_eq_right fun h ↦ hν' (Fin.ext h).symm)
      (fun h ↦ absurd (Finset.mem_univ ν) h), ite_eq_left rfl]
  let f : Submodule.span R (Set.range v) →ₗ[R] R := ∑ ρ, g ρ • b.coord ρ
  have hf : f = 0 := LinearMap.ext_on Submodule.span_span_coe_preimage fun x hx ↦ by
    obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := hx
    obtain rfl : x = ⟨v ν, Submodule.subset_span ⟨ν, rfl⟩⟩ := Subtype.ext hν.symm
    simpa only [f, a, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      Module.Basis.coord_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] using hcoeff ν
  simpa only [f, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.Basis.coord_apply,
    Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true, LinearMap.zero_apply] using
    LinearMap.congr_fun hf (b ρ₀)

    {P : MvPolynomial (Option τ) R} {n l : ℕ}
    (hP : P = ∑ ν : Fin (n + 1), X none ^ (ν : ℕ) * rename some (coeffNone P ν))
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin l) R
      (Submodule.span R (Set.range (fun ν : Fin (n + 1) ↦ coeffNone P ν)))) :
    P = ∑ ρ, Polynomial.aeval (X none : MvPolynomial (Option τ) R) (∑ ν : Fin (n + 1),
        Polynomial.C (b.repr ⟨coeffNone P ν, Submodule.subset_span ⟨ν, rfl⟩⟩ ρ) *
          Polynomial.X ^ (ν : ℕ)) * rename some (b ρ : MvPolynomial τ R) := by
  let a := fun (ν : Fin (n + 1)) ρ ↦ b.repr ⟨coeffNone P ν, Submodule.subset_span ⟨ν, rfl⟩⟩ ρ
  have hexp : ∀ ν : Fin (n + 1), coeffNone P ν = ∑ ρ, a ν ρ • (b ρ : MvPolynomial τ R) := fun ν ↦ by
    have h := congrArg Subtype.val (b.sum_repr ⟨coeffNone P ν, Submodule.subset_span ⟨ν, rfl⟩⟩)
    simpa only [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul] using h.symm
  change P = ∑ ρ, Polynomial.aeval (X none : MvPolynomial (Option τ) R)
    (∑ ν : Fin (n + 1), Polynomial.C (a ν ρ) * Polynomial.X ^ (ν : ℕ)) *
      rename some (b ρ : MvPolynomial τ R)
  conv_lhs => rw [hP]
  simp_rw [hexp, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ρ _ ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ν _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_smul, smul_eq_C_mul, map_mul, Polynomial.aeval_C, algebraMap_eq, map_pow,
    Polynomial.aeval_X]
  ac_rfl

private lemma exists_coeffNone_basis_aux {P : MvPolynomial (Option τ) K} (hP : P ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hP' : P = ∑ ν : Fin (n + 1), X none ^ (ν : ℕ) * rename some (coeffNone P ν)) :
    ∃ l, ∃ b : Module.Basis (Fin l) K
      (Submodule.span K (Set.range (fun ν : Fin (n + 1) ↦ coeffNone P ν))),
      1 ≤ l ∧ l ≤ n + 1 ∧ ∀ ρ j, degreeOf j (b ρ : MvPolynomial τ K) ≤ degreeOf (some j) P := by
  classical
  let v : Fin (n + 1) → MvPolynomial τ K := fun ν ↦ coeffNone P ν
  let V := Submodule.span K (Set.range v)
  have : FiniteDimensional K V := FiniteDimensional.span_of_finite K (Set.finite_range v)
  let b := Module.finBasis K V
  have hl1 : 1 ≤ Module.finrank K V := by
    obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ : ∃ ν, v ν ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra! h
      apply hP
      change P = ∑ ν : Fin (n + 1), X none ^ (ν : ℕ) * rename some (v ν) at hP'
      rw [hP']
      simp [h]
    exact Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.2
      ⟨⟨v ν, Submodule.subset_span ⟨ν, rfl⟩⟩, fun h ↦ hν (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩
  have hdegree : V ≤ restrictSupport K {d | ∀ j, d j ≤ degreeOf (some j) P} :=
    Submodule.span_le.2 (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun (ν : Fin (n + 1)) d hd j ↦ by
      simpa using monomial_le_degreeOf (some j)
        ((mem_support_coeff_optionEquivLeft K).1 hd))
  exact ⟨Module.finrank K V, b, hl1,
    (finrank_range_le_card (R := K) v).trans_eq (Fintype.card_fin _),
    fun ρ j ↦ degreeOf_le_iff.2 fun d hd ↦ hdegree (b ρ).2 hd j⟩

theorem exists_separated_representation {P : MvPolynomial (Option τ) K} (hP : P ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : degreeOf none P ≤ n) :
    ∃ l, 1 ≤ l ∧ l ≤ n + 1 ∧ ∃ (φ : Fin l → Polynomial K) (ψ : Fin l → MvPolynomial τ K),
      LinearIndependent K φ ∧ LinearIndependent K ψ ∧ (∀ ν, (φ ν).natDegree ≤ n) ∧
      (∀ ν j, degreeOf j (ψ ν) ≤ degreeOf (some j) P) ∧
      P = ∑ ν, Polynomial.aeval (X none : MvPolynomial (Option τ) K) (φ ν) * rename some (ψ ν) := by
  classical
  let v : Fin (n + 1) → MvPolynomial τ K := fun ν ↦ coeffNone P ν
  have hP' : P = ∑ ν : Fin (n + 1), X none ^ (ν : ℕ) * rename some (v ν) := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun ν ↦ X none ^ ν * rename some (coeffNone P ν))]
    exact eq_sum_X_none_pow_mul_coeffNone P hn
  obtain ⟨l, b, hl1, hl2, hdegree⟩ := exists_coeffNone_basis_aux hP hP'
  refine ⟨l, hl1, hl2, fun ρ ↦ ∑ ν : Fin (n + 1),
      Polynomial.C (b.repr ⟨v ν, Submodule.subset_span ⟨ν, rfl⟩⟩ ρ) * Polynomial.X ^ (ν : ℕ),
    fun ρ ↦ (b ρ : MvPolynomial τ K), linearIndependent_coordinate_polynomials_aux v b,
    b.linearIndependent.map' (Submodule.span K (Set.range v)).subtype
      (Submodule.ker_subtype _), ?_, hdegree,
    eq_sum_aeval_basis_coeffNone_aux hP' b⟩
  exact fun ρ ↦ Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ fun ν _ ↦
    (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _).trans (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 ν.2)

    hasseDeriv_rename_mul_aeval]

source:
theorem exists_primitive_smul_eq {σ : Type*} {G : MvPolynomial σ ℚ} (hG : G ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (g : ℚ) (U : MvPolynomial σ ℤ), g ≠ 0 ∧ map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) U = g • G ∧
      U.support.gcd (fun d ↦ U.coeff d) = 1 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, U0, hN, hU0⟩ := exists_nat_smul_eq_map G
  have hne : U0.support.Nonempty := support_nonempty.mpr fun h ↦ by
    simpa [h, smul_eq_zero, hN.ne', hG] using hU0.symm
  obtain ⟨g', hg', hg1⟩ := Finset.extract_gcd (fun d ↦ U0.coeff d) hne
  set g0 := U0.support.gcd (fun d ↦ U0.coeff d) with hg0def
  have hg0 : g0 ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hne
    rw [hg0def, Ne, Finset.gcd_eq_zero_iff]
    exact fun h ↦ mem_support_iff.1 hd (h d hd)
  set U := ∑ d ∈ U0.support, monomial d (g' d) with hUdef
  have hUcoeff : ∀ d, U.coeff d = if d ∈ U0.support then g' d else 0 := by
    simp [hUdef, coeff_monomial, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  have hU0coeff : ∀ d, U0.coeff d = g0 * U.coeff d := by
    intro d
    by_cases hd : d ∈ U0.support
    · simpa [hUcoeff, hd] using hg' d hd
    · simp [hUcoeff, hd, notMem_support_iff.1 hd]
  refine ⟨N / g0, U, div_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hN.ne') (by exact_mod_cast hg0), ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext d
    have h1 := congrArg (fun P ↦ P.coeff d) hU0
    simp only [coeff_map, coeff_smul, smul_eq_mul, eq_intCast] at h1 ⊢
    rw [hU0coeff] at h1
    push_cast at h1
    rwa [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff (by exact_mod_cast hg0), mul_comm]
  · have hsupp : U.support = U0.support := by
      ext d
      simp [mem_support_iff, hU0coeff d, hg0]
    rw [hsupp, ← hg1]
    exact Finset.gcd_congr rfl fun d hd ↦ by rw [hUcoeff, ite_eq_left hd]

        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ by rw [mul_assoc, hw i hi]

    P = ∑ d ∈ Roth.box r, C (eval α (hasseDeriv d P)) * ∏ j, (X j - C (α j)) ^ d j := by
  have h1 : taylor α P = ∑ d ∈ Roth.box r, monomial d (eval α (hasseDeriv d P)) := by
    ext e
    simp only [coeff_taylor, coeff_sum, coeff_monomial, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    split_ifs with he
    · rfl
    · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, r j < e j := by
        simpa [Roth.mem_box] using he

  calc P = taylor (fun j ↦ -α j) (taylor α P) := (taylor_neg_taylor α P).symm
    _ = _ := by
      rw [h1, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ ↦ ?_
      rw [taylor_monomial, Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ fun _ ↦ pow_zero _]
      simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

theorem exists_eq_pow_mul_of_rootMultiplicity {R : Polynomial ℤ} {h : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hcop : IsCoprime h (q : ℤ)) : ∃ Q : Polynomial ℤ, R =
      (Polynomial.C (q : ℤ) * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h) ^
      Polynomial.rootMultiplicity ((h : ℚ) / q) (R.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) * Q := by
  set t := Polynomial.rootMultiplicity ((h : ℚ) / q) (R.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ))
  have hq' : (q : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq.ne'
  have hmap : (Polynomial.C (q : ℤ) * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h).map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) =
      Polynomial.C (q : ℚ) * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ((h : ℚ) / q)) := by
    rw [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.map_X,
      Polynomial.map_C, mul_sub, ← Polynomial.C_mul, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hq']
    simp
  apply (Polynomial.IsPrimitive.Int.dvd_iff_map_cast_dvd_map_cast _ _
    (isPrimitive_pow (isPrimitive_linear hcop) t)).2
  rw [Polynomial.map_pow, hmap, mul_pow, ← Polynomial.C_pow,
    Polynomial.C_mul_dvd (pow_ne_zero _ hq')]
  exact Polynomial.pow_rootMultiplicity_dvd _ _

theorem pow_rootMultiplicity_le {R : Polynomial ℤ} (hR : R ≠ 0) {h : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hcop : IsCoprime h (q : ℤ)) {B : ℝ} (hB : |(R.leadingCoeff : ℝ)| ≤ B) :
    (q : ℝ) ^ Polynomial.rootMultiplicity ((h : ℚ) / q) (R.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) ≤ B := by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := exists_eq_pow_mul_of_rootMultiplicity hq hcop
  set t := Polynomial.rootMultiplicity ((h : ℚ) / q) (R.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ))
  have hlc : R.leadingCoeff = (q : ℤ) ^ t * Q.leadingCoeff := by
    rw [hQ, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_pow, sub_eq_add_neg,
      ← Polynomial.C_neg, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_linear (by exact_mod_cast hq.ne')]

      (right_ne_zero_of_mul (hQ ▸ hR)))
  rw [hlc] at hB
  push_cast at hB
  rw [abs_mul, abs_pow, Nat.abs_cast] at hB
  exact (le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity) h1).trans hB

private lemma index_unique_le_log_div [Unique σ] {B : ℝ} {q r : σ → ℕ} (hq : 1 < q default)
    {R : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} (hR : R ≠ 0) (hRB : |((uniqueAlgEquiv ℤ σ R).leadingCoeff : ℝ)| ≤ B)
    {h : σ → ℤ} (hh : IsCoprime (h default) (q default : ℤ)) :
    index (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) R) (fun j ↦ (h j : ℝ) / q j) r ≤
      Real.log B / (r default * Real.log (q default)) := by
  classical
  let R1 : Polynomial ℤ := uniqueAlgEquiv ℤ σ R
  have hmapeq : uniqueAlgEquiv ℝ σ (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) R) =
      R1.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) := by
    dsimp only [R1]
    ext n
    rw [coeff_uniqueAlgEquiv, Polynomial.coeff_map, coeff_uniqueAlgEquiv, coeff_map]
  have hmult : Polynomial.rootMultiplicity ((h default : ℝ) / q default)
      (R1.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) =
      Polynomial.rootMultiplicity ((h default : ℚ) / q default) (R1.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) := by
    rw [Polynomial.eq_rootMultiplicity_map (f := Rat.castHom ℝ) Rat.cast_injective,
      Polynomial.map_map]
    congr 1
    simp
  rw [index_unique ((map_ne_zero_iff _ (map_injective _ Int.cast_injective)).2 hR), hmapeq, hmult]
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (q default : ℝ) ^
    Polynomial.rootMultiplicity ((h default : ℚ) / q default) (R1.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)))
    (pow_rootMultiplicity_le ((map_ne_zero_iff _ (uniqueAlgEquiv ℤ σ).injective).2 hR)
      (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hq) hh hRB)
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hlog
  simpa [div_div, mul_comm] using
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      ((le_div_iff₀ (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hq))).2 hlog) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

  have hnlt : θ * r < n + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hsum := congrArg (Nat.cast (R := ℝ)) (Finset.sum_range_id_mul_two (n + 1))
  push_cast [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hsum

    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
    push_cast

    linear_combination hsum / 2 + sq_nonneg a / 6 + (le_trans (Nat.cast_nonneg n) hnle) / 2 +
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hnle) (sub_nonneg.mpr hnlt.le) / 2

      simp only [Finset.sum_div, sub_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hr.ne']

    _ ≤ ∑ ν ∈ Finset.range l, max 0 (θ - ν / r) :=

        ((Nat.floor_lt (mul_nonneg hθ hr.le)).2 hl))
        fun _ _ _ ↦ le_max_left _ _

    {U : MvPolynomial τ ℤ} (hU : U ∈ RSet M (fun j ↦ l * r (some j))) {V : Polynomial ℤ}
    (hV : V ≠ 0) (hVd : V.natDegree ≤ l * r none) (hVc : ∀ b, |(V.coeff b : ℝ)| ≤ M) :
    index (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)
        (rename some U * Polynomial.aeval (X none : MvPolynomial (Option τ) ℤ) V))
      (fun j ↦ (h j : ℝ) / q j) r ≤ l * lem6Φ q r M l := by
  classical
  set V' : MvPolynomial Unit ℤ := (uniqueAlgEquiv ℤ Unit).symm V with hV'
  have hV'0 : V' ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [hV', ne_eq, map_eq_zero_iff _ (uniqueAlgEquiv ℤ Unit).symm.injective]
  have hVmem : V' ∈ RSet M (fun _ : Unit ↦ l * r none) := by
    refine ⟨hV'0, fun j ↦ ?_, fun d ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [Subsingleton.elim j default, hV', degreeOf_uniqueAlgEquiv_symm]
      exact hVd
    · rw [hV', MvPolynomial.coeff_uniqueAlgEquiv_symm]
      exact hVc _
  have hinjV : Function.Injective (fun _ : Unit ↦ (none : Option τ)) :=
    fun a b _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim a b
  have hmU : map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) U ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦
    hU.1 (map_injective _ Int.cast_injective (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  have hmV : map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) V' ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦
    hV'0 (map_injective _ Int.cast_injective (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  rw [aeval_X_eq_rename, _root_.map_mul, map_rename, map_rename,
    index_mul ((map_ne_zero_iff (rename (R := ℝ) some)
      (rename_injective _ (Option.some_injective _))).2 hmU)
      ((map_ne_zero_iff (rename (R := ℝ) (fun _ : Unit ↦ (none : Option τ)))
        (rename_injective _ hinjV)).2 hmV) _ hr0,
    index_rename (Option.some_injective _), index_rename hinjV]
  have hUΘ := index_le_Θ hU (h := h ∘ some)
    fun j ↦ hh (some j)
  have hVΘ := index_le_Θ hVmem

  rw [index_mul_left_weights] at hUΘ hVΘ
  have hlR : (0 : ℝ) < l := by exact_mod_cast hl
  rw [lem6Φ, mul_add, add_comm]
  exact add_le_add ((div_le_iff₀' hlR).1 hVΘ) ((div_le_iff₀' hlR).1 hUΘ)

    {D : Fin l → (τ →₀ ℕ)} {U : MvPolynomial τ ℤ} {V : Polynomial ℤ} (hU : U ≠ 0) (hV : V ≠ 0)
    (hUd : ∀ j, degreeOf j U ≤ l * r (some j)) (hVd : V.natDegree ≤ l * r none)
    (hF : (Matrix.of fun μ ν : Fin l ↦
        hasseDeriv ((D μ).mapDomain some + Finsupp.single none (ν : ℕ)) R).det =
      rename some U * Polynomial.aeval (X none : MvPolynomial (Option τ) ℤ) V) :
    index (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) (Matrix.of fun μ ν : Fin l ↦
        hasseDeriv ((D μ).mapDomain some + Finsupp.single none (ν : ℕ)) R).det)
      (fun j ↦ (h j : ℝ) / q j) r ≤ l * lem6Φ q r (lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l) l := by
  classical

  have hFcoef (d) : |(((Matrix.of fun μ ν : Fin l ↦ hasseDeriv
      ((D μ).mapDomain some + Finsupp.single none (ν : ℕ)) R).det.coeff d : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤
      lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l := by

      Fintype.card_option, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_id, pow_mul, mul_right_comm] using

        ((abs_nonneg ((R.coeff 0 : ℤ) : ℝ)).trans (hR.2.2 0)) hR.2.2 d

    rw [hF, coeff_rename_mul_aeval, Int.cast_mul, abs_mul] at h1
    exact (le_mul_of_one_le_right (abs_nonneg _) (by
      exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 hV))).trans h1
  have hVc : ∀ b, |((V.coeff b : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l := fun b ↦ by
    obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := MvPolynomial.ne_zero_iff.1 hU
    have h1 := hFcoef (a₀.mapDomain some + Finsupp.single none b)
    rw [hF, coeff_rename_mul_aeval, Int.cast_mul, abs_mul] at h1
    exact (le_mul_of_one_le_left (abs_nonneg _) (by
      exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs ha₀)).trans h1
  -- Step 3: Lemma 4-2, the index of the product of polynomials in separate variables.
  rw [hF]
  exact index_separated_mul_le_aux hr0 hh hl ⟨hU, hUd, hUc⟩ hV hVd hVc

private lemma weight_le_delta_aux {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) {r : Option τ → ℕ}

  classical
  by_cases hr : r none = 0
  · rw [(Finsupp.degree_eq_zero_iff d).1 (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (hr ▸ hd))]
    simpa [weight] using hδ
  have hrp : (0 : ℝ) < r none := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hr
  calc weight (r ∘ some) d = ∑ j, (d j : ℝ) / r (some j) := rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ j, (d j : ℝ) * δ / r none := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦ by
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (pos_of_mul_pos_right (hrp.trans_le (hratio j)) hδ) hrp, mul_assoc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hratio j) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = δ * d.degree / r none := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_mul, Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, Nat.cast_sum, mul_comm]
    _ ≤ δ := (div_le_iff₀ hrp).2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by exact_mod_cast hd) hδ)

name: Roth.index_numeric_bound_aux
source:
private lemma index_numeric_bound_aux {θ Φ δ rp l : ℝ} (hΦ : 0 ≤ Φ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hrp : 3 ≤ rp)
    (hl : 0 < l) (hl' : l ≤ rp + 1) (hmin : min (l * θ / 2) (rp * θ ^ 2 / 3) ≤ l * (Φ + δ)) :
    θ ≤ 2 * (Φ + √Φ + √δ) := by
  -- The small-index comparison `δ ≤ √δ` also controls the linear bound.
  have hsΦ : 0 ≤ √Φ := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hrp0 : 0 < rp := (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3).trans_le hrp
  rcases min_le_iff.1 hmin with hk | hk
  · have hθ : θ ≤ 2 * (Φ + δ) := by
      rwa [mul_div_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hl, div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num), mul_comm] at hk
    linarith only [hθ, Real.le_sqrt_self_iff.2 hδ1, hsΦ]
  · have hsq : θ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (Φ + δ) := (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hrp0).1 (by
      have hsize : 3 * l ≤ 4 * rp := by linarith only [hl', hrp]
      linear_combination 3 * hk + mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsize
        (nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right
          ((div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hrp0.le (sq_nonneg θ)) (by norm_num)).trans hk) hl))
    have hθ : θ ≤ 2 * (√Φ + √δ) := le_of_sq_le_sq (by
      linear_combination hsq + 4 * ((le_max_left δ 0).trans_eq (Real.sq_sqrt').symm) +
        4 * (Real.sq_sqrt hΦ).symm + 8 * mul_nonneg hsΦ (Real.sqrt_nonneg δ)) (by positivity)
    linarith only [hθ, hΦ]

name: Roth.index_le_lem6
source:
theorem index_le_lem6 {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) {r : Option τ → ℕ}
    (hrp : 3 ≤ (r none : ℝ)) (hratio : ∀ j, (r none : ℝ) ≤ δ * r (some j)) {r₁ : ℕ}
    (hr₁ : ∀ j, r j ≤ r₁) {q : Option τ → ℕ} (_hq : ∀ j, 0 < q j) {B : ℝ}
    {R : MvPolynomial (Option τ) ℤ} (hR : R ∈ RSet B r) {h : Option τ → ℤ}
    (hh : ∀ j, IsCoprime (h j) (q j : ℤ)) : ∃ l, 1 ≤ l ∧ l ≤ r none + 1 ∧
      index (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) R) (fun j ↦ (h j : ℝ) / q j) r ≤
        2 * (lem6Φ q r (lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l) l +
          √(lem6Φ q r (lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l) l) + √δ) := by
  -- Retain the paper's positive-denominator setting.
  classical
  have hrp0 : (0 : ℝ) < r none := (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3).trans_le hrp
  have hr0 : ∀ j, 0 < r j := fun j ↦ by
    cases j with
    | none => exact_mod_cast hrp0
    | some j => exact_mod_cast pos_of_mul_pos_right (hrp0.trans_le (hratio j)) hδ0
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hl', D, hD, U, V, hU, hV, hUd, hVd, hF⟩ := exists_det_eq_mul hR.1 hR.2.1
  refine ⟨l, hl, hl', ?_⟩
  let α : Option τ → ℝ := fun j ↦ (h j : ℝ) / q j
  let Φ := lem6Φ q r (lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l) l
  -- The two bounds for the index of `F`.
  have hlower := sum_max_sub_le_index_det D hD (mapped_det_ne_zero_aux hU hV hF) α hr0
    (fun d hd ↦ weight_le_delta_aux hδ0 hratio (hd.trans (Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add.2 hl')))
  have hupper := index_det_le hr0 hr₁ hR hh hl hU hV hUd hVd hF
  simp only [RingHom.map_det, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map, Matrix.of_apply] at hupper
  simp only [hasseDeriv_map] at hlower
  -- Both summands of `Φ` are nonnegative.
  apply index_numeric_bound_aux (Φ := Φ) (l := (l : ℝ))
    (add_nonneg (Θ_nonneg _) (Θ_nonneg _)) hδ1 hrp
    (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < l from hl))
    (by exact_mod_cast hl')
  exact (min_le_sum_max (θ := index (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) R) α r) (rp := r none) l).trans
    (by simpa only [mul_add] using sub_le_iff_le_add.1 (hlower.trans hupper))

private lemma factorial_coefficient_le_two_pow_aux (p r₁ l : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ 2 ^ r₁) :
    (r₁ + 1) ^ (p * l) * l.factorial * 2 ^ (p * l * r₁) ≤ 2 ^ ((2 * p + 1) * r₁ * l) := by
  calc

          gcongr
          · exact Nat.lt_two_pow_self

    _ = 2 ^ ((2 * p + 1) * r₁ * l) := by
      rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add, ← pow_add]
      ring_nf

    rw [ha, ← Real.rpow_mul_natCast hδ0.le, pow_succ]
    congr 1

    exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_left h

private lemma theta_prefix_lt_aux {n : ℕ} {δ ε M : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδε : δ ≤ ε)
    {r q : Fin (n + 2) → ℕ} (hanti : ∀ j, r (Fin.last (n + 1)) ≤ r j)
    (hrlast : 3 ≤ (r (Fin.last (n + 1)) : ℝ))
    (hratio : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), (r i.succ : ℝ) ≤ δ * r i.castSucc)
    (hq1 : ((n : ℝ) + 1 + 1) * (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1 + 1) + 1) / δ ≤ Real.log (q 0))
    (hqr : ∀ j, (r 0 : ℝ) * Real.log (q 0) ≤ r j * Real.log (q j)) {l : ℕ} (hl : 1 ≤ l)
    (hM1 : 1 ≤ M) (hM : M ≤ (q 0 : ℝ) ^ (ε * (l * r 0)))
    (ih : ∀ {r q : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ}, 3 ≤ (r (Fin.last n) : ℝ) →
      (∀ i : Fin n, (r i.succ : ℝ) ≤ ε * r i.castSucc) →
      ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) + 1) / ε ≤ Real.log (q 0) →
      (∀ j, (r 0 : ℝ) * Real.log (q 0) ≤ r j * Real.log (q j)) →
      Θ ((q 0 : ℝ) ^ (ε * r 0)) q r < 10 ^ (n + 1) * ε ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))) :
    Θ M (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦ q j.castSucc) (fun j ↦ l * r j.castSucc) <
      10 ^ (n + 1) * ε ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) := by
  refine (Θ_mono hM1 hM _).trans_lt ?_
  have hCeq : (q 0 : ℝ) ^ (ε * (l * r 0)) =
      (q (Fin.castSucc 0) : ℝ) ^ (ε * ((l * r (Fin.castSucc 0) : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    simp [Nat.cast_mul]
  rw [hCeq]
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n + 1 + 1 :=
    add_nonneg (add_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) zero_le_one) zero_le_one
  refine ih (r := fun j ↦ l * r j.castSucc) (q := fun j ↦ q j.castSucc) ?_ ?_
    ((div_le_div₀ (mul_nonneg hn (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hn) zero_le_one)) (by
      linarith only [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]) hδ0 hδε).trans hq1) ?_
  · have h2 : (r (Fin.last (n + 1)) : ℝ) ≤ r (Fin.castSucc (Fin.last n)) := by
      exact_mod_cast hanti _
    push_cast
    exact hrlast.trans (h2.trans
      (le_mul_of_one_le_left (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast hl)))
  · intro i
    push_cast
    calc
      (l : ℝ) * r (Fin.castSucc i.succ) ≤ l * (δ * r (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castSucc i))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hratio (Fin.castSucc i)) (Nat.cast_nonneg l)
      _ = δ * (l * r (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castSucc i))) := mul_left_comm _ _ _

private lemma theta_lt_of_large_delta_aux {n : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ δ)
    {r q : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ} :
    Θ ((q 0 : ℝ) ^ (δ * r 0)) q r < 10 ^ (n + 1) * δ ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) := by
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) < n + 1 := by positivity
  have hp2 : (n : ℝ) + 1 < (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  calc
    Θ ((q 0 : ℝ) ^ (δ * r 0)) q r ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
      simpa using Θ_le_card (r := r) q
    _ < 10 ^ (n + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) :=
      (lt_div_iff₀ hp).2 <| calc
        ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * 2 ^ (n + 1) :=
          mul_self_lt_mul_self hp.le hp2
        _ = (4 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) := by
          rw [← mul_pow]
          norm_num
        _ ≤ (10 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) _
    _ = 10 ^ (n + 1) * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := (mul_one_div _ _).symm
    _ ≤ 10 ^ (n + 1) * δ ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        ((Real.self_le_rpow_of_le_one (by positivity)
          ((div_le_one hp).2 (by linarith only [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]))
          (pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (by norm_num))).trans
          (Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) hδ (by positivity))) (by positivity)

    _ < 10 ^ (n + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) :=

theorem Θ_lt (n : ℕ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 < δ) {r q : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ}
    (hrlast : 3 ≤ (r (Fin.last n) : ℝ)) (hratio : ∀ i : Fin n, (r i.succ : ℝ) ≤ δ * r i.castSucc)
    (hq1 : ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) + 1) / δ ≤ Real.log (q 0))
    (hqr : ∀ j, (r 0 : ℝ) * Real.log (q 0) ≤ r j * Real.log (q j)) :
    Θ ((q 0 : ℝ) ^ (δ * r 0)) q r < 10 ^ (n + 1) * δ ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) := by
  induction n generalizing δ with
  | zero =>
    have hr : 0 < r 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)
        (by simpa using hrlast : (3 : ℝ) ≤ r 0))
    by_cases hδ : δ ≤ 1
    · exact theta_lt_base_aux hδ0 hδ hr
        (theta_denominators_one_lt_aux hr (lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hq1) hqr 0)
    · exact theta_lt_of_large_delta_aux (by simpa using (not_le.mp hδ).le)
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hδ : δ ≤ 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1 + 1)
    · exact theta_lt_succ_aux hδ0 hδ hrlast hratio
        (by simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hq1) hqr (fun {δ} hδ0 _ ↦ ih hδ0)
    · exact theta_lt_of_large_delta_aux
        (by simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using (not_le.mp hδ).le)

theorem coeff_wronskian_of_natDegree_injective {φ : Fin l → K[X]} :
    (wronskian φ).coeff (∑ ν, (φ ν).natDegree - ∑ ν : Fin l, (ν : ℕ)) = (∏ ν, (φ ν).leadingCoeff) *
      (Matrix.of fun μ ν : Fin l ↦ ((φ ν).natDegree.choose μ : K)).det := by
  classical
  have key (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) : (∏ i, hasseDeriv (σ i : ℕ) (φ i)).coeff
      (∑ ν, (φ ν).natDegree - ∑ ν : Fin l, (ν : ℕ)) =
      ∏ i, ((φ i).natDegree.choose (σ i) : K) * (φ i).leadingCoeff := by
    by_cases h : ∀ i, (σ i : ℕ) ≤ (φ i).natDegree
    · rw [← Equiv.sum_comp σ (fun i : Fin l ↦ (i : ℕ)), ← Finset.sum_tsub_distrib _ fun i _ ↦ h i,
        coeff_prod_of_natDegree_le' _ _ _ fun i _ ↦ natDegree_hasseDeriv_le _ _]
      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
      rw [hasseDeriv_coeff, Nat.sub_add_cancel (h i), leadingCoeff]
    · push Not at h
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
      rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_lt_natDegree _ _ hi),
        coeff_zero]
      exact (Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (by simp [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hi])).symm
  rw [wronskian, wronskianMatrix, Matrix.det_apply', Matrix.det_apply', finsetSum_coeff,

theorem sum_natDegree_update_lt {φ : Fin l → K[X]} (hφ : LinearIndependent K φ) {ν ν' : Fin l}
    (h : ν ≠ ν') (hdeg : (φ ν).natDegree = (φ ν').natDegree) : ∑ ρ, (Function.update φ ν'
      (φ ν' - C ((φ ν').leadingCoeff / (φ ν).leadingCoeff) * φ ν) ρ).natDegree
      < ∑ ρ, (φ ρ).natDegree := by
  set a := (φ ν').leadingCoeff / (φ ν).leadingCoeff
  have h0 : ∀ i, φ i ≠ 0 := hφ.ne_zero
  have hlc : (φ ν).leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 (h0 ν)
  have hne : φ ν' - C a * φ ν ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using (linearIndependent_update_sub_smul h a hφ).ne_zero ν'
  have hdeg' : degree (φ ν') = degree (C a * φ ν) := by
    rw [degree_C_mul (div_ne_zero (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 (h0 ν')) hlc),
      degree_eq_natDegree (h0 ν), degree_eq_natDegree (h0 ν'), hdeg]
  have hlt : (φ ν' - C a * φ ν).natDegree < (φ ν').natDegree :=
    natDegree_lt_natDegree hne (degree_sub_lt_left hdeg' (h0 ν') (by
      rw [leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_C, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hlc]))
  refine Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun i _ ↦ ?_) ⟨ν', Finset.mem_univ _, by simpa⟩
  by_cases hi : i = ν'
  · simpa [hi] using hlt.le
  · simp [Function.update_of_ne hi]

theorem wronskian_ne_zero_of_linearIndependent [CharZero K] {φ : Fin l → K[X]}
    (h : LinearIndependent K φ) : wronskian φ ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  induction hN : ∑ ρ, (φ ρ).natDegree using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing φ with | _ N ih =>
    by_cases hinj : Function.Injective fun ν ↦ (φ ν).natDegree
    · exact wronskian_ne_zero_of_natDegree_injective h.ne_zero hinj
    obtain ⟨ν, ν', hdeg, hne⟩ := Function.not_injective_iff.1 hinj
    rw [← wronskian_update_sub_smul hne ((φ ν').leadingCoeff / (φ ν).leadingCoeff)]
    exact ih _ (hN ▸ sum_natDegree_update_lt h hne hdeg)
      (linearIndependent_update_sub_smul hne _ h) rfl
